**Daily Macro Digest — 28 July 2026**

**Summary:** The standout story today is a sharp reversal in oil, with WTI down 8.2% and Brent down 9.1% — both unusually large moves. This came alongside a notable drop in the US 10-year Treasury yield (down 1.3%, also a large move for a single day). Gold and silver ticked up modestly (+0.36% and +0.21%) but nowhere near enough to register as unusual. The US Dollar Index and VIX were essentially flat, AUD/USD nudged up 0.34%, and the ASX materials basket (BHP, RIO, FMG, NST) rose a healthy 1.94%. Much of the news wire was inaccessible today (multiple feeds returned errors), so context is thinner than usual and comes mainly from oil-sector headlines.
